name: Copeland Furniture Factory Outlet
old_description: Copeland Furniture has been designing and manufacturing natural hardwood furniture for over 50 years, using hardwoods sustainably harvested in the Northeast. We create durable furniture with timeless designs that will last for generations. Visit our Factory Outlet located in Bradford, Vermont to explore our furniture in person.
about:
Copeland Furniture Factory Outlet operates in Bradford, Vermont, as the direct retail arm of Copeland Furniture, a company that has been designing and manufacturing natural hardwood furniture for over 50 years. The business uses hardwoods sustainably harvested in the Northeast, though the exact founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed.

The outlet showcases the manufacturer’s full range of bedroom, dining, living room, and home office collections, along with factory seconds marked down due to cosmetic flaws. In addition to its own hardwood pieces, the store stocks Italian mattresses. The operation combines manufacturing, finishing, and assembly of solid-wood furniture with a retail showroom and a designer trade program.

Customers include residential buyers across Northern New England and other regions not covered by Copeland’s dealer network, as well as interior designers who qualify for the company’s Designer Program. The outlet serves both walk-in shoppers and trade clients seeking sustainable, domestically produced hardwood furniture.

Copeland emphasizes clean design, fine quality, and value, positioning its products as durable pieces meant to last generations. The factory-outlet model allows the company to offer seconds and discontinued styles at a substantial discount while maintaining control over design and production.
